title: Portable Core & Standalone Repos
desc: First-party engines as standalone repos that also run from a CLI.
lede: Engines are built to live as their own repos and even run outside Studio from a CLI.
body:
In progress — the standalone harness is firming up in Phase 12.
At a glance
  • Engine repo layout (XTTS as the example).
  • A CLI entry point and dependency path.
  • A standalone builder harness.

Repo layout

Each engine is a self-contained repo (XTTS is the worked example) that Studio installs via git. The same folder runs in Studio and on its own.

CLI & harness

A CLI entry point lets an engine run without the app, which is handy for development and testing. A builder harness helps package and verify a standalone engine.
